Line 26 keeps the words "eligible Pending payment orders" but, under Time to pay for payments outside the platform, reads as a time limit for an offline-method order to be paid, which no cited WooCommerce source says. fix: Keep the quote and add the source's scope: WooCommerce's Hold Stock cancels "eligible Pending payment orders created through checkout", while its offline methods set an order to On hold (bank transfer) or Processing (cash on delivery); or drop WooCommerce from Time to pay.
